exposure: Good knowledge vs. poor knowledge of essential newborn care
outcome: Maternal knowledge of essential newborn care
Maternal practice of essential newborn care
cohort: Postnatal mothers (n = 384) recruited from postnatal and vaccination clinics in Gadarif city, eastern Sudan
finding: This study found that approximately two-thirds of the participants had good knowledge and practice of essential newborn care, with poor knowledge being associated with poorer practices, but no association was found between sociodemographic and obstetric factors and knowledge or practice.
